full_name: Sonja Drobnic | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Sonja Drobnic has been engaged in a cross-national, longitudinal study of spouses’ careers, analyzing the dynamics of employment patterns and following transitions into retirement in the household.
